environment.description: ECS Fargate service running identical Node.js 18 container. The ALB has an associated CloudFront distribution with a custom origin response policy that appends integrity metadata. The task definition includes a sidecar container running an Envoy proxy (v1.28) configured with a Lua filter that intercepts outbound HTML responses and injects SRI integrity attributes (sha384 hashes) on all <script> tags matching the CDN origin pattern before forwarding to the client. The Envoy filter references a hash manifest file mounted from an EFS volume that is updated by a separate CodePipeline stage whenever CDN assets are published. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM condition key restriction (aws:ResourceTag/integrity-verified = true) scoped to the S3 CDN origin bucket, and the CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy with Content-Security-Policy: require-sri-for script set. The Envoy Lua filter also strips any response body content where script src attributes don't have a matching entry in the integrity manifest, replacing them with a nonce-gated inline error handler.

config.envoy_sidecar: v1.28 with Lua response filter for SRI injection
config.envoy_lua_filter: injects integrity='sha384-...' on script tags, strips unmatched scripts
config.iam_condition: aws:ResourceTag/integrity-verified=true on CDN S3 bucket access
